en.title: Comparing Left and Right Range Sums
en.description:
Given an integer array, count the ways to cut it into two non-empty contiguous parts so that the sum of the left part is strictly greater than the sum of the right part.

Integer sums use arbitrary precision; the standard input/output protocol and the upper bound on n are explicitly supplied by this site.

This site adds a standard input/output protocol; this does not mean the original function-style problem had this protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200000), and the second line contains n integers with absolute values at most 10^9.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying cuts.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the problem rules, approach, and proof.
hints: Accumulate the prefix sum and compare it with the total minus the prefix sum.
